artifacts.summary: Re-derives both findings from first principles: finding (2) (task-reference lint debt) is already fully closed by dependency tasks 766/771 (verified 0 occurrences, no code change needed); finding (1) (specs-only covering-check gap) is confirmed and root-caused to verify-deploy.sh gate 4's SKIP guard being factually wrong for check-task-references.sh (mirrors gate 3's correct-but-inapplicable premise), plus plan-format.md's __FULL_SWEEP__ guidance recommending --only-gate 3,4 with no explicit TARGET, which is silently vacuous from any ordinary dispatch cwd -- confirmed by a second real-world occurrence in task 720's artifacts, not only the specs/**-only case named in the dispatch description.

memory_candidates.content: In verify-deploy.sh (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts), each gate's deploy-consumer SKIP guard (checking `! -d "$TARGET/agent-system/extensions"`) must be individually verified against its own underlying script's real precondition -- it is not safe to copy a neighboring gate's guard. Gate 3's guard is correct (check-extension-docs.sh genuinely requires agent-system/extensions). Gate 4's guard was copied from gate 3 but is wrong: check-task-references.sh is explicitly designed to be repo-appropriate and runs a real check in any deploy-consumer repo with no dependency on agent-system/extensions. 17 other gates (5-13,15,17-22) carry the same guard shape and are unaudited.

plan-format.md's __FULL_SWEEP__ covering-check guidance ("ordinarily --only-gate 3,4") omits an explicit TARGET argument, so verify-deploy.sh's TARGET defaults to $(pwd) -- the dispatch's cwd, which is the deploy-consumer repo root in every ordinary dispatch, never the source-store checkout. This makes the guidance silently vacuous (0 checks, exit 0) both for specs/**-only phases (specs/** is also the task-reference lint's own exempt tree by design, so even a fixed gate can't inspect it) and for genuine source-store markdown edits verified from a consumer repo's cwd -- confirmed as having already occurred in a real task (720) outside the specs/**-only case.

For a plan phase whose entire Files to modify set lies under specs/**, the correct covering check is validate-artifact.sh <path> <type> (report/plan/summary types) or the prose-tier diff read-through -- never verify-deploy.sh gates 3/4, since specs/** is the task-reference lint's own path-level exemption (category 1 in task-reference-exemptions.md) and doc-lint has no relation to specs/** content either.
